items.title: Did SMCI Stock Just Rise For The Wrong Reason?
items.summary: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) stock rose 9.5% on Thursday, September 17, closing just over $40. The move followed a bullish call on how big the market for AI servers gets. That call may well be right. But it answers a question Super Micro's own results never raised. That is why one big session tells you less than it looks like it does.

items.title: Can Hewlett Packard Enterprise Stock Keep Running On Orders It Cannot Ship?
